title: The Half-Light Silence
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
